notes.title: Small Update/Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your continued support. Based on your feedback, I’ve released the first update to make the game more challenging. I’ve made several adjustments to the units, enemies, and the boss. Additionally, enemies will now grow stronger after every 2nd consecutive wave, instead of every 5th wave.

Changes to Training Units


 Placing multiple units of the same type will now require additional food and population resources. 
 If a unit is killed by enemies, the cost for that unit will decrease by 1 food and 1 population.

Boss Adjustments:

 Increased Boss HP by 20%.

Unit Balancing

Bot Wheel

 Reduced HP.

Spirit Boxer

 Slightly increased health.
 Slightly increased attack speed.

Droid Assassin

 Reduced attack damage.
 Slightly increased attack speed.

Lost Welder

 Slightly increased health.

Guardian

 Slightly increased damage.

Mage Samurai

 Decreased HP.
 Slightly increased attack.

Samurai Bandit

 Slightly increased health.
 Slightly increased attack speed.

Storm Samurai

 Reduced damage and health.
 Slightly increased attack speed.

Stormhead

 Reduced health.
 Slightly reduced attack.
